regression_scenarios.query: Trong các loại dầu gội, loại nào có giá thấp nhất?
assertions: lowest price is derived by paging the complete matching catalog category
only minimum-price products are returned, including ties
answer includes snapshot date and price/stock caveats
category switch does not reuse previously shown shampoo IDs
all equal minimum-price matches are returned

regression_scenarios.query: Nước giặt nào có giá thấp nhất?
assertions: both recommend_products and search_products ranking paths are covered
answer names the catalog minimum rather than only listing prices

regression_scenarios.query: thịt thăn bò loại nào giá thấp nhất?
assertions: query remains scoped to products matching beef tenderloin wording
does not widen to an unrelated cheapest meat product

regression_scenarios.query: tìm sản phẩm giá thấp nhất giúp tôi
assertions: asks which product group to compare
does not fabricate a lowest item

limitations: The snapshot is dated 2026-09-15; current in-store price and availability are not verified.
Lowest price means listed package price; differing package sizes are not normalized per unit.
No independent human review, blind-set evaluation, or production load test was performed.
